title: NO-Not for the price of $100-
text:
NO-Not for the price of $100-. I have a small original Z pillow I got 4 years ago from Malouf (this company).. It is soft but firm.Its my FAV pillow but they dont make it anymore apparently, SO I got this cool malouf pillow queen size. I was so excited to get another Z pillow, but now am very disappointed. This new Carbon Cool Z pillow is ABSOLUTELY way TOO SOFT. NO support for neck AT ALL. I have had many memory foam pillows over the years and a few were over $100, like this one. This is the only Expensive pillow that I really feel is NOT worth what I paid for it. I wish Malouf would just make more of the ORIGINAL Z pillow & the travel size.
Unless u want an extremely mushy Soft chunk of foam that leaves your head basically as flat as hitting the bottom of the bed when u lay on it, I would suggest you save your $100 and pass this Carbon cool pillow for something else.

product_metadata.title: Z CARBONCOOL LT Plus OMNIPHASE Phase Change Material Memory Foam Pillow - Continual Temperature Regulation with Cool Surface - Mid-Loft - Queen
features: Infused with activated carbon and phase change material for constant temperature regulation
Activated carbon infused in the foam creates pathways that move heat away from the head and neck
Surface coated with OMNIPHASE phase change material, an advanced cooling technology that continuously absorbs and dissipates heat
Soft, supportive memory foam relieves pressure points; ventilated for increased airflow and breathability
TENCEL mesh removable cover with superior moisture-management properties aids in optimal sleeping temperatures; 5-year warranty guarantees high-quality construction
description: The most advanced pillow-cooling technology available, OMNIPHASE phase change material provides continual temperature regulation with ventilation for superior airflow. Phase change molecules capture and release heat as needed to maintain the optimum sleep temperature throughout the night. To further the cooling properties, activated carbon infused in the foam creates a pathway to filter heat away from the head, face, and neck. Now you can enjoy the pressure-relieving benefits of memory foam while sleeping at the perfect temperature. Lastly, a TENCEL mesh cover creates a soft, smooth surface that helps control humidity while allowing maximum exposure to the OMNIPHASE coating. For every pillow purchased, the Malouf Foundation will donate a significant portion to fight child sexual exploitation.
